docs.title: What is MkDocs?

docs.title: Setup Instructions
docs.text:
The Talaria 6 family is a suite of comprehensive SoCs featuring ultra-low-power Wi-Fi 7, multi-protocol connectivity, and enhanced cybersecurity. By integrating the high-performance Green Tea Studio™ (GTS) development environment, the Talaria 6 platform provides a trusted, secure, and fast path to commercial-grade IoT solutions.

The Talaria 6 family features ultra-low-power Wi-Fi 7 and multi-protocol connectivity, providing a secure path for commercial-grade IoT solutions.

For an overview, please refer to the Introduction.

docs.title: Register Demo: SYSTEM_CONFIG
docs.text: This page demonstrates how MkDocs handles complex bit-field tables using a mix of Markdown and HTML.

docs.title: Register: 0x40004000 (SYS_CFG)
docs.text: Bit Name Type Reset Description 31:16 RESERVED - 0x0000 - 15:8 MODE RW 0x01 See Mode Table below 7:0 STATUS RO 0xAF Device status flags

docs.title: Detailed Mode Configuration
docs.text:
Standard Markdown cannot span rows, so we use HTML for this complex section:

Mode ID Capability Description Wi-Fi BLE 0x01 Dual Enabled Standard operation mode with both radios active. 0x02 Single Disabled Power-saving mode for Wi-Fi only tasks.
